description: Edit an active watch: change webhook/Slack URLs, liveness sensitivity, or subscribed events. Bearer-authed with the secret from x402_watch_create. Newly-added URLs are connection-tested before the change is persisted; if any new URL fails, the existing config is unchanged. Delivery fields are full-replace per channel (omit to leave that channel unchanged). Returns the updated watch view.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (default all). Omit to keep current events.

secret.description: The one-time bearer secret returned by x402_watch_create.

slack_url.description: Replace Slack/Discord URL(s). Single string or array; max 5. Omit to keep current URL(s).

webhook_url.description: Replace webhook URL(s). Single string or array; max 5. Omit to keep current webhook(s).

name: x402_watch_edit
title: x402 watch — edit delivery URLs / sensitivity / events (free)
